title: Why Flipkart's Ek Size Bada Le Lo ad works

outro.cta: Follow for marketing that actually works

scenes.vo: Every Indian kid has heard this line from mum.
scenes.visual: A mum says 'Ek size bada le lo'; small echoes of the same line pop up from other homes.

scenes.vo: School shirt? One size bigger. Shoes? One size bigger. So you could grow into them.
scenes.visual: A school shirt grows as S, M, L tags light up one by one.

scenes.vo: Flipkart's Big Billion Days film by 22feet took that exact rule, and pointed it at a TV.
scenes.visual: The shirt becomes a TV that grows 43, 55, 65 inch with a lime glow.

scenes.vo: The story is simple. A childhood rule. A grown up, nervous to pitch a bigger TV to the family. Mum's own rule becomes the argument. And sale prices close the deal.

data.note: BEATS AS DESCRIBED BY FLIPKART · 80 S FILM

scenes.visual: A 2x2 storyboard strip; each beat card lights up on its word.

scenes.vo: Why it works. First, it starts with a truth almost every Indian home shares. Nobody needs it explained.
scenes.visual: A grid of homes lights up one by one, each with the same mum line.

scenes.vo: Second, it kills the real objection. A big TV feels like an indulgence. Mum's rule turns it into common sense.
scenes.visual: Three family objections get struck through; mum's line lands as the answer.

scenes.vo: Third, nostalgia softens price pain. Research in the Journal of Consumer Research found nostalgia weakens the desire for money.

data.source: LASALETA, SEDIKIDES & VOHS · JOURNAL OF CONSUMER RESEARCH, 2014

scenes.visual: A warm sepia wash spreads; the price-pain meter shrinks.

scenes.vo: Here's how the agency put it.

data.quote: The creative unlock was using that mantra, typically reserved for apparels, for a category like large screen TVs.

scenes.visual: The quote reveals word by word; the key words glow lime.

scenes.vo: Want your own version? Do what Clay Christensen's team did. Spend a day where your customers buy. Ask what almost stopped them. Then find the phrase they already use, and build your ad around it.
scenes.visual: A field notebook fills with observations; the last line highlights lime.

scenes.vo: So, what's the one line your mum always said? Drop it in the comments.
scenes.visual: A happy mum figure; example comment replies with classic mum lines stack up.
